to_device: move all tensors in a nested object tree to a specified CUDA or CPU device
expand_right: expand a tensor by adding trailing dimensions to match a target shape
get_stats: compute min, max, mean, median, and std statistics for a PyTorch tensor
tree_transpose_level_one: transpose the outer and inner levels of a nested tree structure using optree
tree_reduce_unique: apply a function to all leaves of a tree and assert all results are identical
